t: Turn sunshowers into crimson confetti for the leprechauns
title: Turn sunshowers into crimson confetti for the leprechauns
name: Turn sunshowers into crimson confetti for the leprechauns
description: The Rainbow Sentinel can turn sunshowers into crimson confetti for the leprechauns. The Sentinel works it under the Absolute Light-Angle Mandate, bending all gloom into harmless light at 42 and 51 degrees - a Signature tale, not a real device.
